findings.message: <div class="brand-glow" data-start="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: <audio> has data-start but no id attribute. The renderer requires id to discover media elements, so this audio will be SILENT in renders.
findings.fixHint: Add a unique id attribute: <audio id="my-audio" ...>

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#incident-card, #intake-card, #workflow, #result-card, #final-mark" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.

findings.message: <div> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
